description: The Meridian Dispatch field record for one place: the best time to go, how long it takes, effort, season, access, how to get there and what goes wrong. Works for sights, trails, scenic drives, events and ski resorts. Takes a meridiandispatch.com page URL, or a name with its town or country.

name.description: The place name, e.g. "Kotor Old Town" or "Grunas Waterfall".
